messages.text: I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Arrow key navigation is restored in [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:27): each press moves one card horizontally or vertically, stops at the board edges, and keeps focus visible. [Card.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Card.tsx:41) handles only arrow keys, so other keys, activation, and Tab behavior remain intact. I also updated the face sheet’s standalone card usage.

Type checking passed; all 138 unit tests and 75 browser journeys passed on the project’s pinned runtime. The four changed files pass Prettier. The full formatting check still flags three untouched files: `scripts/replay.test.ts`, `tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`, and `tests/layout.e2e.test.ts`.

Cleanup of generated, ignored dependency and build directories was blocked because the command runner rejected `rm -rf`; those directories remain in the workspace.
